Unauthorized Access to Kinesis Data Stream [Spoofing, Tampering, Information Disclosure, CWE-284] on KinesisDataStreams, preprocessing_lambda: Attackers could use stolen credentials or exploit overly permissive IAM roles to access the Kinesis stream, potentially reading sensitive data or injecting malicious records. An attacker with compromised Lambda credentials could modify the data stream to inject false anomalies or suppress real ones.

ML Model Artifact Tampering [Tampering, Repudiation, Information Disclosure, CWE-434] on S3, SagemakerModel, anomaly_lambda: Attackers could exploit misconfigured S3 bucket permissions or compromised credentials to modify or replace ML model artifacts. An attacker uploads a malicious model that deliberately misclassifies anomalies, causing the system to miss critical alerts.

Lambda Function Code Injection [Tampering, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-94] on preprocessing_lambda, anomaly_lambda, notification_lambda: Attackers might exploit poor input validation or environment variable handling to execute arbitrary code within Lambda functions. An attacker injects malicious code through specially crafted input data that exploits string evaluation or deserialization vulnerabilities.

DynamoDB Data Exposure [Information Disclosure, Tampering, CWE-359] on Dynamodb, preprocessing_lambda, anomaly_lambda: Attackers could exploit overly permissive IAM policies or application-level vulnerabilities to access or modify sensitive data in DynamoDB. An attacker uses a compromised Lambda function to scan the DynamoDB table and extract historical anomaly data.

Frontend Application Attack Surface [Spoofing, Tampering, Information Disclosure, CWE-79] on CloudFront, Amplify, WebUI: Attackers could exploit client-side vulnerabilities, manipulate API calls, or perform cross-site scripting attacks against the web interface. An attacker injects malicious JavaScript through a cross-site scripting vulnerability, stealing user session tokens.

SageMaker Endpoint Manipulation [Tampering, Denial of Service, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-400] on SagemakerModel, anomaly_lambda: Attackers could overwhelm the SageMaker endpoint with requests or attempt to poison the model through carefully crafted inputs. An attacker floods the SageMaker endpoint with requests, causing delays in anomaly detection and potential missed alerts.

SNS Alert Manipulation [Tampering, Repudiation, Denial of Service, CWE-287] on SNS, notification_lambda: Attackers could attempt to suppress legitimate alerts or generate false alerts by manipulating the SNS topic or compromising the notification Lambda. An attacker with compromised credentials modifies SNS subscriptions to prevent alerts from reaching security teams.

Monitoring System Bypass [Repudiation, Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-778] on Cloudwatch, Lambda, Kinesis, SagemakerModel: Attackers could modify CloudWatch alarms, delete logs, or disable monitoring to hide malicious activities. An attacker with elevated privileges disables CloudWatch alarms and deletes logs to hide their activities.
